headline: Network Administrator

experience.title: Network Administrator
bullets: Run the core and distribution network for an internet provider with about 9,000 fibre subscribers in Camarines Sur.
Designed a redundant ring between three points of presence, so one cut fibre no longer takes a town offline.
Manage firewall policies, access control lists and VPNs, and review logs for unusual traffic every morning.
Harden servers and network devices after each vendor advisory and track what is still exposed.
Moved monitoring and backups to Microsoft Azure, cutting on-site hardware costs.

experience.title: Network Support Technician
bullets: Handled second-level technical support for business subscribers and configured their routers on site.
Kept the ticket queue under the two-day target during the 2022 typhoon season restorations.

summary: Network administrator with four years at regional internet providers. I design and run routed networks, manage firewalls and VPNs, keep devices patched and watch for suspicious traffic. I explain outages and changes clearly to managers and field teams.
skills: Network administration and network engineering (OSPF, BGP, VLANs)

education.credential: Bachelor of Science in Information Technology
